title: Scalar unit equation for a fixed strict comparison
statement: For fixed normalized scalar compatibility and strict scalar comparison data, the scalar-adjunction unit agrees with extension by zero on every cochain complex.

source.place: Tags 03DI, 03EK, 0E8I and 0941; generator formula for the unit and extensionality.

proof.text: Evaluate the strict tower maps at an arbitrary level and degree, and rewrite r.components with all arguments specified. The source is the actual open extension of the corresponding module.

Apply open-extension Hom extensionality (the localized extension adjunction), reducing equality to each original extension summand. Naturality of extensionSection computes extension of the unit. The finite tensor comparison generator formula followed by ScalarCompatibility.sections gives exactly that same generator. Equality in all degrees and levels proves the strict tower equation, with no boundedness or flatness assumption. The implementation reuses the proved private extensionSection_ext and extensionSection_map helpers from OpenScalarTransitionCompatibility and OpenFiniteScalarComparison.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03DI and 03DA (extension generator extensionality) and 0E8I (finite tensor generator comparison), applied degreewise to strict towers.

lean.statement:
theorem openQuotientScalarUnitEquation
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j)
    (tc : IntegralOpenReduction.TensorComparison l E j o)
    (sc : ScalarCompatibility l E j o)
    (r : ScalarComparison l E j o sc tc) :
    ∀ P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E U) ℤ,
      scalarUnitTower l E X ((OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o).obj P) ≫
          r.iso.hom.app P =
        (Functor.constComp ℕᵒᵖ P (OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o)).inv ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight (scalarUnitTower l E U P)
            (OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o)
